Item.Name: DEVICE_MODE
Item.Description: Selection between: - 0: Relay mode - 1: LoRa Logger mode - 2: LTE Logger mode

Item.Name: POWER_MODE
Item.Description: Selection between: - 0: Always On (AO) mode - 1: Hibernate mode

Item.Name: TX_INTERVAL
Item.Description: Frequency device wakes up, takes readings, and stores to flash. Interval is always synched to the clock. E.g. interval of 900 seconds (15 mintues) will log readings at 12:00:00, 12:15:00, 12:30:00, etc. Interval of 1 at 12:00:00, 12:01:00, 12:02:00, etc.

Item.Name: LOG_INTERVAL
Item.Description: Frequency device wakes up, takes readings, and stores to flash. Interval is always synched to the clock. E.g. interval of 900 seconds (15 mintues) will log readings at 12:00:00, 12:15:00, 12:30:00, etc. Interval of 1 at 12:00:00, 12:01:00, 12:02:00, etc.

Item.Name: LOG_INTERVAL_ALARM
Item.Description: Frequency readings are recorded when an ALARM_THRESHOLD is crossed.

Item.Name: TX_DELAY
Item.Description: Random value between 0 - 29500, rounded to closest 200 ms. Number of ms after TX_INTERVAL, for transmitting data. Minimizes LoRa collisions and server load. For a logger, random value between 0 and 29500, rounded to closest 200 ms. Random value determined at first transmit, then saved if transit was successful, resets again if ACK not immediately received.

Item.Name: WAKE_EARLY
Item.Description: How much earlier than TX_INTERVAL a Relay wakes up to listen for loggers. Helps catch logger with clocks that are slightly fast. Only valid for DEVICE_MODE= 0

Item.Name: RX_DURATION
Item.Description: Default value: 120 How long Relay stays in RX mode. Only valid for DEVICE_MODE = 0.
